scope: A02 only; fixed 38980 English articles; no minimum words or duplicate exclusions
unit: one article, equal weight within each year; equal weight across years within each comparison period
quantiles: linear interpolation including observed zeros, excluding only metric-specific NA

bootstrap.unit: all known single numeric author IDs across 2018-2025 sampled together with replacement; all their articles retained
bootstrap.p_values: not_run; no optional six-metric tests or Holm adjustment

M02: mean of positive-word P sentence lengths, terminal fragments included; n=0 => NA
M03: population SD / mean of positive-word P sentence lengths; n<2 => NA; 2-4 retained and flagged
M04: 1000 * P non-numeric-internal commas / W_P; W_P=0 => NA; zero commas => 0

secondary.sentence_burstiness: (CV-1)/(CV+1), same information as CV, n<2 => NA
secondary.adjacent_sentence_difference_mean: mean absolute difference of adjacent positive-word sentence lengths within each P owner; zero-word units skipped as in T02; no pair => NA
secondary.equal_adjacent_sentence_share: exactly equal word-count adjacent pairs / all same-owner positive-word sentence pairs; no pair => NA; exploration, no readability claim
secondary.single_sentence_paragraph_rate: P owners with exactly 1 positive-word sentence / all P owners, including zero-word owners; no P owner => NA
secondary.paragraph_sentence_count_cv: population SD / mean of positive-word sentence counts across all P owners, zero counts included; fewer than 2 owners or mean=0 => NA
secondary.comma_interval_sentence_mean: split every saved P machine sentence at non-numeric-internal commas; include leading/trailing zero-word intervals and zero-word sentences; no comma gives 1 interval; count saved ASCII word tokens per interval then average within article; no P sentence units => NA
secondary.comma_interval_sentence_mean_ge5commas: same article-level value conditional on >=5 P commas, threshold fixed before annual summaries; below threshold => NA
secondary.comma_interval_legacy_article_proxy: existing T02 W_P/(commas+1) retained under explicit legacy name; W_P=0 => NA; not a sentence-interval measure

sensitivity_deferred_to_V01: CV restricted to >=5 positive-word P sentences
word-count bands and paragraph-length matched comparisons
quality-flag influence and segmentation error sensitivity
quality_diagnostics: no exclusion; annual zero/one/low sentence counts, zero-word machine units, terminal fragment counts, P/L separation, deterministic 2 diagnostic cases per year (low n and extreme CV), first 3 P owners up to 600 characters
